cards.mood: The piece opens with a reflective, narrative intimacy that quickly swells into a confident, high-energy declaration of independence.
cards.palette: A grand piano serves as the harmonic anchor throughout the entire track, providing rhythmic comping in the verses and sweeping chordal support in the choruses.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He stood beneath the velvet light
With shadows dancing on the floor
He traded secrets for the night
And stepped through every open door
[Pre-Chorus]
No longer bound by the heavy crown
He found the path that led him down
[Chorus]
He broke the glass and claimed the sky
With every breath, a brand new high
No longer waiting for the tide to turn
He took the fire that he had to burn
[Verse]
The script was written in his veins
A steady rhythm in the bone
He broke the iron, rusted chains
To walk a kingdom of his own
[Pre-Chorus]
The echoes faded in the hall
He stood upright, proud and tall
[Chorus]
He broke the glass and claimed the sky
With every breath, a brand new high
No longer waiting for the tide to turn
He took the fire that he had to burn
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Like a leaf upon a silent stream
He drifted deep into a waking dream
[Chorus]
He broke the glass and claimed the sky
With every breath, a brand new high
No longer waiting for the tide to turn
He took the fire that he had to burn
[Outro]
